result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred position, including the required standards, durations, remedies, legal compliance, and malicious-code protection. It therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. The amendment is confined to the requested warranty protections and leaves the existing representations and Globix provision intact. Drafting is substantively clear, though “in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner” is slightly repetitive and the singular phrase “this warranty” could more precisely refer to all warranties in Section 9(c).
